## Digital Loyang campus, Singapore

One campus/site contains SIN11 (Digital Loyang I, 3 Loyang Way, 508719) and SIN12 (Digital Loyang II, 11 Loyang Close, 506756). Digital Realty's historical release explicitly says the buildings are adjacent and names the Digital Loyang campus. The operator still identifies both separately at those addresses. A single combined existing-operations project avoids double counting a named adjacent campus.

Status is **operational as of 24 August 2026**, 65 days before this review, from Digital Realty's dated release that Singapore has three operational data centres. The operator's metro page identifies the exact set as SIN10, SIN11 and SIN12, while the historical release identifies SIN12 as the third centre. This is a cross-source identity mapping; the 24 August release does not list individual codes in its operating sentence. It is the same status evidence used for the already-admitted SIN10. Do not derive an opening date from the historical release or assign the release's aggregate ~84 MW to either Loyang building. Jurong Island is a separate future facility.

Location is the direct SLA OneMap point of SIN12 at **103.9662820345768, 1.370840569410011**, explicitly scoped as a campus locator on that component, not a campus centroid. SIN11 has its own exact official address point at **103.9682391257187, 1.371009970310877**, about 218 m east. Both postal-code queries returned one exact address. Campus grouping rests on the operator's explicit campus/adjacency statement, not distance alone.

The canonical 24 August release capture from the prior SEA packet was copied unchanged into this packet (`raw/dlr-pr-singapore-50mw-20260824-canonical.html`, SHA-256 `c5e4db4b354ce9fcee0bf365982496cf9ba9198618d723f44ec4ff985e812557`). Full press text is in the Next.js `__NEXT_DATA__` object under `/props/pageProps/data/field_template_blocks/2/template_text_block_type/field_template_text/0/value`. The visible banner is 25 August but the article dateline is 24 August; the latter is used. The equivalent investor PDF was readable through the web tool, but direct raw requests to that PDF and investor newsroom returned HTTP 403. Both failures are retained; no retry/bypass occurred. The canonical prior capture time remains unchanged, rather than pretending it was freshly retrieved.

Bounded 28 October operator-domain searches for SIN11/SIN12 found no later physical-state successor. The November 2026 DRIL laboratory in SIN11 is a demonstrator inside the existing site, excluded from additions. The Digital Core REIT fractional-property transaction is not a physical phase.

## Gore Hill Data Centre, Artarmon, Australia

Status is **operational as of 30 September 2026**, 28 days before review. The Keppel DC REIT 3Q 2026 presentation (published 23 October) page 20 explicitly dates its portfolio table to 30 September. The Gore Hill row has 8 clients, 84.8% occupancy, 90,955 sq ft attributable lettable area, 100% property interest, and fully-fitted colocation plus shell-and-core triple-net lease space. This supports ongoing operations but not an assertion that all space is fitted or energized. End-2026 contract-start forecasts are excluded from the physical-status observation. The PDF table was rendered and visually read.

Identity comes from Annual Report 2025, printed page 44 / physical PDF page 41: **5 Broadcast Way (South Gate), Artarmon NSW 2064**. That PDF page was also rendered and visually read. The official NSW AddressPoint `rid=2979390`, `gurasid=75125312`, `principaladdresssiteoid=3345786` returns this exact address and direct WGS84 point **151.18640556534911, -33.819980050903055**. Its uncertainty field is null. The point happens to coincide with a previously computed property centroid, but this packet obtains it directly from the government address layer and performs no coordinate derivation.

Fresh official property records show property **3611417**, identically listed as 5 and 5A Broadcast Way, contains the Gore Hill point. Existing NEXTDC S3 is **196 m** away and lies inside separate property **3611419**, 2 Broadcast Way. Existing Frederick Street (309 m) and Goodman SYD01 (374 m) points are outside Gore Hill's polygon. Point-in-polygon checks are saved in `geometry-review.json`. S6 is not an existing Atlas record and its exact property is unpublished; no S6 equivalence or tenant is asserted. The annual report names a colocation facility manager, but this is not promoted to a whole-site operator role; only the directly supported REIT owner role is included.

Fresh copies of the Q3 presentation and annual report match prior admitted hashes exactly, so the original canonical source metadata is retained for evidence-ID reuse. Local metadata separately records fresh capture times. NSW data is marked `no-open-license-asserted`, SLA geometry retains OneMap terms, and operator documents remain all-rights-reserved. Raw captures are ignored local review material and are not redistributed.

# Americas review — 28 October 2026

Two new physical-site admissions are prepared, each with one announced 2026 capacity-expansion project: Claro Triara Bogotá at Celta Trade Park Bodega 32, Funza; and Claro Triara Megacenter Medellín at Carrera 43B No. 23–66. Their status date is the operator announcement of 28 August 2026, 61 days before this update. No construction or operating status is assigned to the expansions. Older operations are identity context only.

The operator release announces Triara positions rated 10–20 kW and a new Megacenter space for 100 positions of up to 10 kVA. No total IT MW is inferred and the shared investment is not allocated by site. The exact successful raw capture and SHA-256 are in sources.json and its metadata. Claro’s robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot.

Capital Salud public tender PDF page 11 visually confirms the Triara Bodega 32 address and former Telmex provider. Claro’s 2025 sustainability PDF page 80 was rendered, OCR-extracted and visually inspected; its named Megacenter address exactly matches Google Maps. Selected Google coordinates are from named result features, not viewport centres: Triara at [-74.1785995, 4.766885] and Megacenter at [-75.5701536, 6.2242122]. Waze corroborates Megacenter within 10 m. Geometry is scoped to the existing facility, with expansion-room and parcel boundaries unknown. Primary identity sources are explicitly linked in locator.identity_source_ids.

OSM direct bounding-box responses had no matching named object and are not selected geometry sources. The unsuccessful HTTP 406 Overpass capture is not used.

Dedupe-review.json records five base-file hashes and nearest-site distances. Before this fragment, 77 base/hold/queue files were screened with no Claro or Triara match. The only matches concerned Telconet. The baseline contains two Colombian sites, ODATA BG01 and Equinix BG2. ODATA BG01 lies 4.59 km from Triara in a different free zone. Megacenter lies 227.5 km from the nearest baseline site.

Bounded primary-domain searches for Triara/Megacenter with September and October 2026, plus the exact 100-position phrase, returned the 28 August release and older identity/certification pages. No later commencement, completion or withdrawal was found. The 5 November 2025 modernisation does not establish completion of the later announced space.

Telconet remains held: the primary status release was discovered in search, but direct operator capture timed out and the precise locator remains unresolved. VAN3 generic page modification and stale ODATA republishing do not renew status.

Only this ignored local directory was written. No tracked source, definition, dataset, config, staging, commit or push was modified. Parent should independently verify and pin the consolidated registry and output before building.

# Europe research packet — 28 October 2026

Four proposed new physical sites/projects against the selected 838-site / 906-project base `verified_construction_core/2026-10-27-research-hundredsecond`:

| Site | Status | Observation | Point scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Hetzner Helsinki, Tuusula | operational | 22 October 2026 | Official address point at Huurrekuja 10 linked to existing campus building/property |
| Hetzner Falkenstein | operational | 27 October 2026 | Named OSM FSN1 campus polygon area centroid |
| Hetzner Nuremberg | operational | 27 October 2026 | Named OSM NBG1 campus polygon area centroid |
| Bitdeer Tydal AI/HPC conversion | announced | 4 August 2026 | Kartverket official representation point for main campus parcel 5033/181/189 |

`changes.json` follows the actual current `dataset_update` input schema, which uses `additions`, not `add_projects`. Its output path is an unused local preview location. The no-write `update_payloads(changes.resolve())` validation passed on 28 October; no preview dataset was generated.

All 16 records in `sources.json` point to successful raw HTTP 200 captures in this folder. SHA-256 values were re-read and checked by `prepare_packet.py` before source construction. Captures include separate metadata. No source, definition, dataset, config or tracked file was edited by this agent.

## Scope and status decisions

- Hetzner's exact-address operator page and location-code/ownership documentation establish campus identity. Dated customer service recovery at HEL1 and NBG1 and completed routine UPS/emergency-power work at FSN1 provide current operational observations. No generic page-modified date is used. HEL1's dated DC7 UPS maintenance is supporting context. No incident is presented as proof that every campus building is operating.
- Cloud datacenter IDs can denote virtual groups of physical buildings. None of these additions identifies a particular physical hall; they are whole-campus records. No capacity is guessed.
- The German polygons carry Hetzner's name, operator, exact address, telecom=data_center and FSN1/NBG1 reference tags. `geometry-facts.json` preserves their vertices, OSM IDs and selected centroid. The point derivation uses the polygon area centroid in a local equirectangular plane. No surveyed boundary or numerical positional accuracy is claimed.
- HEL1 uses the Ryhti address feature `open_permit_address.331a7dd1-c922-43a1-81c6-bf07e3a26e81`, linked to building `1035983807` and property `85841100030138`. It is not asserted to locate DC7 or the Object Storage cluster. An older hold for a different 9,347 m² building at the same address stays unresolved.
- Tydal's 4 August operator release is a current, explicit AI/HPC lease announcement (85 days before review), supporting announced status. The October municipal construction-traffic notice is retained as raw context only: its visible date is `Sist endret`, not a dated event. No upgrade to construction is proposed. The 19 October Bitdeer operations release, readable through web retrieval, still treats the AI facility's completion/performance as future; direct raw capture returned HTTP 403 and is retained as a failed retrieval, not admitted as a source.
- Tydal's selected point is the official WGS84 representation point of the main 181/189 parcel. The municipal plan page 9 map was visually checked against the parcel/address chain. The operator footer street number 190 is on adjacent 181/191; address 196 is on 181/189. This distinction is explicit in the record. The wider proposed 170 daa zoning envelope is not a permit, footprint, or separate site.

## Deduplication and successor checks

All five selected base tables and all 72 published `sources/*holds.json` files were searched for candidate names, aliases, operator names, address fragments and codes. Nearest physical-site points were calculated against all 838 base sites; results are in `dedup-review.json`.

Broad matches were individually reviewed: HEL1 matches Microsoft's HEL17/HEL18 strings, and `datacenter park` matches CtrlS sites in India. These are unrelated. No actual candidate appears in the base. Nearest existing Atlas sites are 22.193 km from HEL1, 100.001 km from FSN1, 9.545 km from NBG1 and 195.201 km from Tydal. Tydal resolves the specific thirtyfirst-holds lead; the Huurrekuja building hold remains held. This repository contains no `claims.tsv` or other queue fragments named `changes.json`; concurrent parent research remains subject to root crosscheck.

Hetzner's status index and pressroom were captured and reviewed for successors. No closure/relocation was found. Tydal operator news and the newer Bitdeer September operations release were checked; neither establishes operating AI capacity. Original raw municipal and operator context is retained without recasting modification or retrieval dates as status dates.

The parent must independently verify the packet before integrating it. The intended addition count is four sites and four projects, with no refresh of existing records.
